about: A4 Fighter-line classes for Growler Mace and Mathien's Metal (20216 belongs to part03)

entries.source: Prima Revised 2002 / Allakhazam Growler's Necklace and The Growling Ghost: Class "Fighter, Cleric"
entries.why: AllowedClasses 14|6 used the base class Fighter (14), which only exists at levels 1-4, while MinLevel is 13, so only Clerics qualified; the Fighter line in 1.65 is Armsman (2), Paladin (1), Mercenary (11) and Reaver (19, base class Fighter)
